---
title: "Supplementary Materials for *Children, but not language models, show accelerating returns in word learning*"
bibliography: ../standard_model.bib
csl: ../science.csl
# Science numbers supplementary items from 1 with a lowercase S prefix: "fig. S1",
# "table S1". The S belongs to the NUMBER, not the label -- putting it in fig-title
# yields "fig. S 1", because Quarto joins label and number with a hardcoded space and
# in PDF that join happens inside LaTeX's caption machinery, out of reach of a Lua
# filter on the Pandoc AST. Redefining \thefigure / \thetable below puts the S in the
# counter itself, so captions and \ref both render "S1" with no stray space.
crossref:
  fig-title: "fig."
  tbl-title: "table"
  fig-prefix: "fig."
  tbl-prefix: "table"
format:
  pdf:
    documentclass: article
    geometry: margin=1in
    fontsize: 11pt
    linestretch: 1.05
    colorlinks: true
    keep-tex: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{booktabs}
        \usepackage{longtable}
        \usepackage{array}
        \usepackage{multirow}
        \usepackage{wrapfig}
        \usepackage{float}
        \usepackage{colortbl}
        \usepackage{pdflscape}
        \usepackage{tabu}
        \usepackage{threeparttable}
        \usepackage{threeparttablex}
        \usepackage[normalem]{ulem}
        \usepackage{makecell}
        \usepackage{xcolor}
        % Supplementary numbering: S1, S2, ... (see the crossref note above)
        \renewcommand{\thefigure}{S\arabic{figure}}
        \renewcommand{\thetable}{S\arabic{table}}
        \floatplacement{table}{H}
        \floatplacement{figure}{H}
---

<!--
Standalone supplement, for Science submission.

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Science requires the supplementary materials as a separate file
("The supplementary materials should be submitted as a single separate file in .docx or
PDF format"), while the working PDF folds them into the main document for review. This
builds the SI on its own from the SAME source -- paper/supplemental.qmd -- so there is one
copy of the supplement, not two that can drift apart.

PDF rather than docx is deliberate and permitted. The SI carries thirteen kableExtra
tables using pack_rows, add_header_above and landscape, none of which survive a Word
conversion; the main text carries no tables at all, so it converts cleanly. Keeping the SI
as PDF avoids rewriting all thirteen for no gain.

The preamble above is what kableExtra injects into the main document; it has to be
declared here because this file does not inherit the main .qmd's header-includes.

Render:  quarto render paper/science/supplement.qmd
-->

```{r si-standalone-setup, include=FALSE}
## Same setup the main manuscript uses. Sourced, not duplicated, so the inline values
## quoted in the SI cannot drift from the ones quoted in the main text.
source(here::here("paper", "_setup_shared.R"))
```
